title: orion-financial-integration-call-notes-2026-04-26
content:
Call notes (sync with Orion Financial infra + security) - 2026-04-25
Participants: Ava Martinez (Redwood SE), Samir Patel (Redwood AE), Vera Kline (Orion lead infra), Diego Alvarez (Orion ML), Priya Rao (Orion security)

High level summary:
- Orion is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for a pilot: customer-facing chat + embeddings search for loan docs.
- Primary constraints: EU data residency for customer PII, strict key management (HSM/KMS), and 99.9% uptime SLA for peak business hours (08:00-20:00 CET).
- Traffic profile: initial pilot ~5k requests/day, spiky bursts up to 200 r/s during business hours for validation batch jobs.
- Latency target: sub-200ms p95 token latency for short chats (<=128 tokens).
- Cost sensitivity: prefer lower-cost quantized model for embedding + generation; willing to accept small quality drop for embeddings but not for conversational answers in regulated contexts.

Notes to self / rough technical requirements:
- Network: VPC peering required, allow egress to KMS endpoint in customer's account. Need diagram of Orion's network (subnets, NAT, firewall rules).
- Auth: Orion must provide IAM role for Redwood to access KMS or we support Bring-Your-Own-KMS (BYOK) via customer HSM. Verify HSM vendor (Thales vs AWS CloudHSM).
- Data flow: input text -> Redwood private runtime (in their VPC) -> model inference -> optionally store transcripts in Orion's S3. Must ensure transcripts encrypted at rest and in transit.
- Model pinning: Orion wants to pin model to a specific open model release (gpt-neox-20b-quant) for the pilot. Need to validate performance on our infra (throughput / memory).
- Caching: we should enable prefix KV caching for repeated queries (search/embeddings). Discussed TTL and cache invalidation policy with Diego.
- Batching: recommended smaller max_batch_size for low-latency endpoints (16?) and larger for embeddings pipeline. Need to run perf tests to produce recommended batch config.
- Metrics: expose per-route token count, latency p50/p95, and cost burn (tokens) to Orion Console. Retention requirements: Orion asked for 90-day logs. Confirm retention SLA.

Gotchas / Risk items:
- Data residency: must ensure no metadata or usage telemetry leaves EU region. Our private control plane currently runs in us-east-1 by default; need to document how control plane traffic will be routed and where telemetry lands. TODO: escalate to infra team.
- BYOK complexity: if Orion insists on HSM, timeline extends by ~3-4 weeks for key exchange, legal & attestation. Clarify what level of attestation they need (FIPS, PCI).
- Model compatibility: gpt-neox-20b-quant has reported instability on some quantized kernels. Run local validation to ensure generation quality for financial Q&A.
- SLA windows: 99.9% during business hours only - we need to model scheduling and on-call coverage. Confirm if they want multi-region fallback for disaster recovery.

Open questions (to resolve before proposal):
1) Exact HSM vendor and whether Orion will provide KMS in their cloud account. (Owner: Priya / Due: 2026-04-29)
2) Acceptable embedding quality degradation threshold (e.g., recall drop <=5%). (Owner: Diego / Due: 2026-04-28)
3) Telemetry routing: can Orion accept anonymized aggregated usage metrics outside EU, or do they require full telemetry residency? (Owner: Ava / Due: 2026-04-27)
4) Peak throughput confirmation: are 200 r/s bursts sustained or short-lived (minutes)? This affects autoscale policy. (Owner: Vera / Due: 2026-04-27)

Action items / next steps:
- Run perf validation for gpt-neox-20b-quant on dedicated pilot nodes (measure p95 token latency @ batch sizes 8/16/32). (Owner: Samir / Due: 2026-05-02)
- Share network diagram template and request Orion network layout. (Owner: Ava / Due: 2026-04-27)
- Draft initial pilot SOW (4-week pilot, cost estimate for dedicated capacity + onboarding), include BYOK and KMS options as addenda. (Owner: Samir / Due: 2026-04-30)
- Prep compliance checklist for Priya: data flow map, KMS attestations, PCI/FIPS requirements. (Owner: Vera + Priya / Due: 2026-04-29)
- Set follow-up call with Orion for 2026-04-28 to answer open questions and confirm pilot scope. Calendar invite pending. (Owner: Ava / Due: ASAP)

Quick sketch of proposal points for pilot (notes to flesh out):
- 4-week Redwood Private pilot in eu-west-1; single AZ deployment with option to enable multi-AZ for DR if needed.
- Dedicated pool sized for 200 r/s bursts (initial estimate: 2x A100 equivalent nodes with autoscale to 4 for peak). Include cost ranges.
- BYOK via AWS CloudHSM or Redwood-managed KMS (with strict telemetry residency) - two tracks in proposal.
- Model choices: primary: quantized embedding + generation model tuned by Redwood; fallback: full precision variant in case of quality regression.
- Observability: 90-day retention for logs, per-route dashboards + alerting for p95 latency, error rates, and cost burn.

Notes to self: keep doc informal - this is customer working notes. Pull in SRE/infra input before sending SOW. Add snippets from prior Harbor Financial pilot as reference for autoscale numbers and cost.

End of notes.
